pages.title: Finding it
pages.text: Look for a small structure made of stone bricks in the Flowerbed.

pages.title: Find the Crystal Ball
pages.text: Explore the dungeon and look for a room with a Crystal Ball.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: Wooden Crates can contain Assassin's Knives, Lutes and Lyres, powerful items.

pages.title: Gold Crates
pages.text: These are very rare, and contain Gold Mob Tokens, which can be traded in Prismacon for powerful weapons.
